---
name: Feature request
about: Propose a new capability or enhancement
title: "[FEAT] "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

### Problem

What are you trying to do, and what's blocking you today? Please describe the real-world workflow (threat modelling, compliance reporting, review flow, etc.) rather than jumping to a solution.

### Proposed solution

How you think this could be solved. Screenshots, wireframes, or API sketches welcome.

### Alternatives considered

Other approaches you've thought about, and why they don't fit.

### Scope sanity-check

Is this feature **in-scope** for a physical security risk assessment platform? Generic project management, ticketing, or IT inventory features are usually redirected — if you're unsure, describe the connection to CSMP / ISO 31000 / NIS2 / ASIS SPC.1.

### Additional context

Related standards, compliance requirements, or links to prior art.
